tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. Night Ink in the console.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, cards, the sidebar and top bar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Drawers, menus, popovers and hovered table rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders, table row dividers, chart gridlines. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders. Holds 3:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the logo's link strokes, on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, table headers, metadata and captions, on ground and surface (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Signal Cyan. The brand color: logo nodes, primary buttons, links, selection, focus rings, info state. As text, on ground and surface.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav item, info banners. signal text reads on it in both themes.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid signal fill (primary buttons). Dark text in the dark theme because the cyan is light.

tokens.name: hearth
tokens.usage: Hearth. Warm brand secondary for presentations, the social card and the cover only. Never used inside the console UI, where warm tones mean warnings.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success state: completed jobs, healthy checks. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning state and the DEV environment badges. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed jobs, destructive actions. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series. Chart series follow chart-1 to chart-8 in order.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Sixth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Seventh chart series.

tokens.name: chart-8
tokens.usage: Eighth series and the 'Other' bucket.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Presentation titles and the social card. Not used in the console.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles in the console (Dashboard, Profiles, a segment name).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Import a source to populate dashboards.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows on KPI tiles and table headers. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables, counts, currency. Tabular numbers.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IDs, JSON, segment definitions, write keys.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Base grid step. Gaps inside controls and between table cell content.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, gaps between form fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding, gaps between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section breaks on dashboards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Presentation and social-card margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, inputs, table row highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, dropdowns.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Drawers, dialogs, large cards.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: App icon tile at 64px (22% of the side). Scale with the icon.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table row height in the console.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width; collapses to 56px.

tokens.name: logo-min-lockup
tokens.usage: Smallest width for the horizontal lockup. Below this use the mark.

tokens.name: logo-min-mark
tokens.usage: Smallest mark size; at 16 to 32px use the favicon file.
